description: This PHP source file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_LoadPlugin, which manages loading plugins dynamically within the Smarty templating engine. It includes methods for searching plugin files across various directories and validating plugin names.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_LoadPlugin
classes.description: A class responsible for loading plugin files into the Smarty environment, caching plugin file paths, and handling plugin name validation and searching across directories.

methods.name: loadPlugin
methods.description: Loads a plugin by its name, searching in predefined directories and cache, and includes the plugin file if found. Throws an exception if the plugin name format is invalid.
